Vendored terminal emulator files from the npm registry. All are unmodified except xterm.css,
which carries a local appendix after the upstream file: the 16-colour ANSI palette and bold/dim
rules for the DOM renderer, matched on exact classes so 256-colour cells (xterm-fg-16..255) keep
the colour xterm computes.

xterm.js, xterm.css    @xterm/xterm 6.0.0             MIT, LICENSE.xterm.txt
addon-fit.js           @xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0        MIT, LICENSE.xterm.txt
addon-unicode11.js     @xterm/addon-unicode11 0.9.0   MIT, LICENSE.xterm-addon-unicode11.txt
